A busy watch guide for anyone travelling with a pet
Readers usually want a clear answer

Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance for pet travel

Aurelia Skyways supports travellers who bring companion animals, and this guide explains the main steps in a calm, practical way. Before travel, review the documents needed for your animal, confirm the crate or carrier is suitable, and make sure the pet is fit for the journey. Clear preparation helps our staff handle each case with care and reduces delays at the skyport.

For rabbits, the health certificate must be current and available for inspection. <<FACT F082>> Keep the document with your travel papers so it can be reviewed without delay. If you are travelling with a reptile, confirm the eligibility rules before booking and prepare any approved enclosure in advance. <<FACT F078>> Early checks are the best way to avoid last-minute disruption.

At the airport, follow the instructions of the ground team and keep your animal secured until you are asked to present it. Handlers use calm, humane methods and will guide you through each step with attention to safety and comfort. If your pet needs water, a brief pause, or a quieter holding area, ask a staff member as soon as possible.

If you are unsure about forms, kennel standards, or route approval, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can review the details and explain the next steps in plain terms. Please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for further help before you travel.
